sloka: तस्य पेतुर्नगा भूमौ हरिवेगाच्च जज्वलुः।शृङ्गाणि च व्यशीर्यन्त पीडितस्य हनूमता ।। ६.७४.३८ ।।
transliteration: tasya peturnagā bhūmau harivegācca jajvaluḥ।śṛṅgāṇi ca vyaśīryanta pīḍitasya hanūmatā ।। 6.74.38 ।।

translations.english: Oppressed by the speed of Hanuman, the mountain fell to the ground and by the impetuosity of his speed the mountain got shattered.
